content:

# Discord. OpenClaw connects to Discord as a bot over the official Discord gateway. DMs and guild channels are supported. Discord DMs default to pairing mode. Create a Discord application with a bot, add the bot to your server, and pair it with OpenClaw. Use a private server if you can; create one first (**Create My Own > For me and my friends**) if needed. - ### Create a Discord application and bot. In the Discord Developer Portal, click **New Application** and name it (for example "OpenClaw"). Open **Bot** in the sidebar and set the **Username** to your agent's name. If the bot will post in threads — including forum or media channel workflows that create or continue a thread — also enable **Send Messages in Threads**. If your host is blocked or rate-limited by Discord's startup application lookup, set the application/client ID from the Developer Portal so startup can skip that REST call: `channels.discord.applicationId` for the default account, or `channels.discord.accounts..applicationId` per bot.

## Scheduling

### One-shot jobs

`--at <datetime>` schedules a one-shot run. Offset-less datetimes are treated as UTC unless you also pass `--tz <iana>`, which interprets the wall-clock time in the given timezone.

`--at <datetime>`
`--tz <iana>`

One-shot jobs delete after success by default. Use `--keep-after-run` to preserve them.

`--keep-after-run`

### Recurring jobs [...] `openclaw cron`

Manage cron jobs for the Gateway scheduler.

Run `openclaw cron --help` for the full command surface. See Cron jobs for the conceptual guide.

`openclaw cron --help`

All cron mutations (`add`/`create`, `update`/`edit`, `remove`, `run`) require `operator.admin`. Command-payload runs execute directly in the Gateway process, not as an agent `tools.exec` tool call; `tools.exec.` and exec approvals still govern model-visible exec tools. [...] `add`

## Create jobs quickly

`openclaw cron create` is an alias for `openclaw cron add`. For new jobs, put the schedule first and the prompt second:

`openclaw cron create`
`openclaw cron add`
`openclaw cron create "0 7   " \ "Summarize overnight updates." \ --name "Morning brief" \ --agent ops`

title: 🦞 Scheduled tasks - OpenClaw
content:
OpenClaw 技术干货

`openclaw cron create` is an alias for `openclaw cron add`. New jobs can use a positional schedule (`"0 9   1"`, `"every 1h"`, `"20m"`, or an ISO timestamp) followed by a positional agent prompt. Use `--webhook <url>` on `cron add|create` or `cron edit` to POST the finished run payload to an HTTP endpoint; webhook delivery cannot combine with chat delivery flags (`--announce`, `--channel`, `--to`, `--thread-id`, `--account`). On `cron edit`, `--clear-channel`, `--clear-to`, `--clear-thread-id`, [...] Command cron is an operator-admin Gateway automation surface, not an agent `tools.exec` call. Creating, updating, removing, or manually running cron jobs requires `operator.admin`; scheduled command runs later execute inside the Gateway process as that admin-authored automation. Agent exec policy (`tools.exec.mode`, approval prompts, per-agent tool allowlists) governs model-visible exec tools, not command cron payloads. [...] ## Configuration
